title: Add A2A delegated repair denial policy
summary: A2A peer repair reports exist, but delegated repair must stay blocked until peer-mismatched repair denial and authorization policy are explicit and tested.
expectedFailureModes: Delegated repair expands without a policy that binds peer_pubkey, task_id, lease_id, and duplicate_risk.
A peer can repair a visible task using a capability scoped to the wrong counterparty.
Repair visibility status reports delegated repair as blocked without machine-checking the denial-policy evidence.
nextAction: Add an A2A delegated repair authorization policy, a validator for the policy/test hooks, and a daemon regression test proving a peer-visible repair still fails when delegated repair scope names the wrong counterparty.
